items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: You see we had Pierrot, we had John Robichon, we had Mac Neal, we had what's the name of that guy that used to lead the Pierrot. Jimmy Palard, those fellows were musicians.

ctx.x: Oh he did it? Bump Johnson got them from a fiddler?

The music? The music itself? Oh. Peter would make anybody play. Peter was considered one of our first class musicians. Oh yeah, Peter's a musician like you see him so. Oh yeah. And Peter could read anything you put there with that violin. I don't know what he could do with the trumpet. I knew he played the trumpet some. But his instrument was violin. You see we had Pierrot, we had John Robichon, we had Mac Neal, we had what's the name of that guy that used to lead the Pierrot. Jimmy Palard, those fellows were…
Orleans Country Club playing concert music. You did? As large as that? How many? 75 or 80?
